description: Find detailed public Austin happy-hour candidates by text, active day/time, category, and proximity. Returns matching schedules, offers, coordinates, source links, revision metadata, straight-line distance in meters, and remaining deal time for crawl planning.

day.description: Austin local weekday. Required when time is provided.

latitude.description: Origin latitude. Must be provided with longitude.

longitude.description: Origin longitude. Must be provided with latitude.

minimumRemainingMinutes.description: Only include active windows with at least this many minutes remaining. Requires day and time.

radiusMeters.description: Maximum straight-line radius from the origin. Requires latitude and longitude.

time.description: 24-hour HH:mm in America/Chicago. Returns programs active at this time.

name: find_happy_hours
title: Find Happy Hours
